title: Hundreds of thousands without water in Puerto Rico
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. The story centers on this: Hundreds of thousands without water in Puerto Rico. In simple words, Families and businesses in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and nearby towns now have to make do with whatever water they have on hand amid rolling shutoffs that last for 48 hours at a time. NBC News' George Solis is on. Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. This is a developing story, and verified details may change later.
